data.title: Unit 9: Heat, light and sound
Heat and light
data.heading: Music
data.text: Music is a collection of many different sounds.
A collection of sounds can be called music when the different sounds are in harmony with each other.
Music is collective sound which is made when the vibration of an instrument causes another instrument to vibrate.
The second object amplifies the sound.
The vibrating string causes the sound box of the guitar to vibrate.
The vibrating action of the sound box in turn causes the air particles inside it to vibrate at the same frequency as the string.
Different musical notes can be created by changing the force and length of the vibrations.
Strings of a guitar can be held down at different points to change the length of the string which creates the vibrations.
Strings can also be tightened and loosened to create different notes.
Wind instruments like the flute have holes that change the length of the column of vibrating air.
